paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-sixth day of the fourth month of Keichō 20, Ōno Shumanosuke Harufusa led more than two thousand troops across the shadowed mountain ridges and set Kōriyama ablaze. Thus began the Osaka Summer Campaign.

units.source_en: On the twenty-sixth day of the fourth month of Keichō 20, Ōno Shumanosuke Harufusa led more than two thousand troops across the shadowed mountain ridges and set Kōriyama ablaze. Thus began the Osaka Summer Campaign.
units.source_zh: 庆长二十年四月二十六，大野主马亮治房率兵两千余，穿过背阴的山岭，放火烧了郡山，大坂夏役由此开始。

paragraphs.source_zh: 庆长二十年四月二十六，大野主马亮治房率兵两千余，穿过背阴的山岭，放火烧了郡山，大坂夏役由此开始。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, every dwelling northeast of Kōriyama had burned to the ground. If nothing were done, the Nara region might soon be reduced to a wasteland of ashes; danger pressed in on every side. Thereupon Matsukura Bungo-no-kami Shigemasa, lord of Gojō Castle and a shogunate magistrate, withdrew with Okuda Tadatsugu toward Kokubu to meet the attack—and Yamato abruptly became a battlefield.

units.source_en: Before long, every dwelling northeast of Kōriyama had burned to the ground. If nothing were done, the Nara region might soon be reduced to a wasteland of ashes; danger pressed in on every side.
units.source_zh: 未几，郡山东北民房悉数焚烧殆尽，倘若置之不理，奈良一带很可能随即化为一片焦土，一时间危机重重。

units.source_en: Thereupon Matsukura Bungo-no-kami Shigemasa, lord of Gojō Castle and a shogunate magistrate, withdrew with Okuda Tadatsugu toward Kokubu to meet the attack—and Yamato abruptly became a battlefield.
units.source_zh: 于是，五条城城主、幕府代官松仓丰后守重正为了迎战，与奥田忠次一起撤退至国分一带——大和顿时成为战场。

paragraphs.source_zh: 未几，郡山东北民房悉数焚烧殆尽，倘若置之不理，奈良一带很可能随即化为一片焦土，一时间危机重重。于是，五条城城主、幕府代官松仓丰后守重正为了迎战，与奥田忠次一起撤退至国分一带——大和顿时成为战场。

paragraphs.source_en: After the Kagenori affair, Harufusa grew deeply suspicious and came to believe that no one could be trusted. He no longer trusted even his elder brother Harunaga or his mother, Ōkurakyō-no-tsubone, let alone ordinary men; and he harbored grave doubts about Hideyori as well.

units.source_en: After the Kagenori affair, Harufusa grew deeply suspicious and came to believe that no one could be trusted.
units.source_zh: 由于景宪之变，治房疑心大起，认为人皆不可信！

units.source_en: He no longer trusted even his elder brother Harunaga or his mother, Ōkurakyō-no-tsubone, let alone ordinary men;
units.source_zh: 别说寻常人，就连亲兄治长和母亲大藏局，他都不再相信；

units.source_en: and he harbored grave doubts about Hideyori as well.
units.source_zh: 对秀赖，他亦疑虑重重。

paragraphs.source_zh: 由于景宪之变，治房疑心大起，认为人皆不可信！别说寻常人，就连亲兄治长和母亲大藏局，他都不再相信；对秀赖，他亦疑虑重重。

paragraphs.source_en: Harufusa was not inciting and coercing Hideyori into war; he himself had no choice but to fight. When he sensed that his brother and mother meant to persuade Hideyori to move to Kōriyama, he forestalled them by burning Kōriyama to the ground and putting an end to the idea. He sent troops to burn, kill, and plunder around Kōriyama and Nara, throwing the region into chaos, and then intended to march directly on Wakayama.

units.source_en: Harufusa was not inciting and coercing Hideyori into war; he himself had no choice but to fight.

ja.t: もうとしていたのではない。

units.source_zh: 治房并不是煽动并挟持秀赖发动战争，而是不得不战。

units.source_en: When he sensed that his brother and mother meant to persuade Hideyori to move to Kōriyama, he forestalled them by burning Kōriyama to the ground and putting an end to the idea.
units.source_zh: 当他隐隐知兄长和母亲想劝秀赖移到郡山，便先人一步，将郡山付之一炬，以绝了他们的念头。

units.source_en: He sent troops to burn, kill, and plunder around Kōriyama and Nara, throwing the region into chaos, and then intended to march directly on Wakayama.
units.source_zh: 他派出军队在郡山和奈良一带烧杀抢掠，大生混乱，然后打算挥兵直指和歌山。

paragraphs.source_zh: 治房并不是煽动并挟持秀赖发动战争，而是不得不战。当他隐隐知兄长和母亲想劝秀赖移到郡山，便先人一步，将郡山付之一炬，以绝了他们的念头。他派出军队在郡山和奈良一带烧杀抢掠，大生混乱，然后打算挥兵直指和歌山。

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing the disorder spread, Itakura Katsushige issued orders to Asano on the twenty-eighth of the fourth month, urging him to take the field at once.

units.source_en: Seeing the disorder spread, Itakura Katsushige issued orders to Asano on the twenty-eighth of the fourth month, urging him to take the field at once.
units.source_zh: 见乱事大起，四月二十八，板仓胜重遂向浅野下令，催促其迅速出兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 见乱事大起，四月二十八，板仓胜重遂向浅野下令，催促其迅速出兵。

paragraphs.source_en: By then, the port of Sakai had already been engulfed in a sea of flames.

units.source_en: By then, the port of Sakai had already been engulfed in a sea of flames.
units.source_zh: 此时， 堺港已淹没在一片火海中。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时， 堺港已淹没在一片火海中。

paragraphs.source_en: “Let no one in the realm be alarmed. All the incendiaries, including the mastermind, are now in the custody of the shoshidai.” Itakura Katsushige circulated this proclamation to calm the populace.

units.source_en: “Let no one in the realm be alarmed. All the incendiaries, including the mastermind, are now in the custody of the shoshidai.”
units.source_zh: “天下当勿虑，包括主谋在内的纵火贼人，已悉数为所司代掌握。”

units.source_en: Itakura Katsushige circulated this proclamation to calm the populace.
units.source_zh: 板仓胜重发放布告，安抚民心。

paragraphs.source_zh: “天下当勿虑，包括主谋在内的纵火贼人，已悉数为所司代掌握。”板仓胜重发放布告，安抚民心。

paragraphs.source_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu, originally due to depart for the campaign on the twenty-eighth, likewise postponed his departure until the third day of the fifth month.

units.source_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu, originally due to depart for the campaign on the twenty-eighth, likewise postponed his departure until the third day of the fifth month.
units.source_zh: 德川家康原定二十八日出征，亦延至五月初三。

paragraphs.source_zh: 德川家康原定二十八日出征，亦延至五月初三。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, the arsonists were led to the execution ground amid the curses of Kyoto’s townspeople. The mastermind was Kimura Sōki, a senior retainer of the Furuta house who had entered Kyoto in secret while acting in concert with Ōno Harufusa; more than thirty men were arrested, including Sōki’s subordinates.

units.source_en: Before long, the arsonists were led to the execution ground amid the curses of Kyoto’s townspeople.
units.source_zh: 未久，纵火之人在京都百姓的骂声中被押赴刑场。

units.source_en: The mastermind was Kimura Sōki, a senior retainer of the Furuta house who had entered Kyoto in secret while acting in concert with Ōno Harufusa; more than thirty men were arrested, including Sōki’s subordinates.
units.source_zh: 主谋是和大野治房相呼应、潜入京都的古田家家老木村宗喜，连同宗喜的属下，一共逮捕了三十余人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 未久，纵火之人在京都百姓的骂声中被押赴刑场。主谋是和大野治房相呼应、潜入京都的古田家家老木村宗喜，连同宗喜的属下，一共逮捕了三十余人。

paragraphs.source_en: Tsutsui Masatsugu, commander of Kōriyama Castle, had abandoned the fortress and fled. The Osaka army reached Nara but lacked the strength to advance farther; otherwise, it would not have been Sakai alone that burned—Nara and Kyoto, those two ancient capitals, would surely have been reduced to ashes.

units.source_en: Tsutsui Masatsugu, commander of Kōriyama Castle, had abandoned the fortress and fled. The Osaka army reached Nara but lacked the strength to advance farther; otherwise, it would not have been Sakai alone that burned—Nara and Kyoto, those two ancient capitals, would surely have been reduced to ashes.

ja.t: はなかった。そうでなければ

units.source_zh: 郡山城守将筒井正次已弃城而逃，大坂军杀到奈良，却是无力再进，否则，被烧掉的便不仅仅是堺港，奈良和京城这两座古城无疑将化为一片焦土。

paragraphs.source_zh: 郡山城守将筒井正次已弃城而逃，大坂军杀到奈良，却是无力再进，否则，被烧掉的便不仅仅是堺港，奈良和京城这两座古城无疑将化为一片焦土。

paragraphs.source_en: People everywhere were deeply anxious. It was because Itakura Katsushige perceived the realm’s alarm that he pressed Asano to march without delay.

units.source_en: People everywhere were deeply anxious. It was because Itakura Katsushige perceived the realm’s alarm that he pressed Asano to march without delay.
units.source_zh: 世人对此忧心忡忡，板仓胜重正是因为察觉了天下之人的忧心，才催促浅野迅速出兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 世人对此忧心忡忡，板仓胜重正是因为察觉了天下之人的忧心，才催促浅野迅速出兵。

paragraphs.source_en: The vanguard of the Yamato-route army under Mizuno Katsushige was hastening toward Nara, but until it arrived, the city remained in danger of destruction. Katsushige judged that this alone was insufficient: only by drawing the Asano army out of Wakayama and placing Ōno Harufusa under enough pressure could they stop him.

units.source_en: The vanguard of the Yamato-route army under Mizuno Katsushige was hastening toward Nara, but until it arrived, the city remained in danger of destruction.
units.source_zh: 以水野胜成为主将的大和口军先锋，正急速朝奈良方向进发，但在他们到达之前，奈良仍然有被毁之险。

units.source_en: Katsushige judged that this alone was insufficient: only by drawing the Asano army out of Wakayama and placing Ōno Harufusa under enough pressure could they stop him.
units.source_zh: 胜重认为，此且不够，只有把浅野军调出和歌山，给大野治房足够的压力，方能阻挡他们。

paragraphs.source_zh: 以水野胜成为主将的大和口军先锋，正急速朝奈良方向进发，但在他们到达之前，奈良仍然有被毁之险。胜重认为，此且不够，只有把浅野军调出和歌山，给大野治房足够的压力，方能阻挡他们。

paragraphs.source_en: “Kyoto and Nara must be protected!” This was Ieyasu’s stern command. Had that stern command not checked them, the Osaka troops would surely have been branded rebels incapable of weighing the Toyotomi house against the two ancient capitals, earning infamy for all time.

units.source_en: “Kyoto and Nara must be protected!”
units.source_zh: “必保京都和奈良！”

units.source_en: This was Ieyasu’s stern command.
units.source_zh: 这是家康下达的严令。

units.source_en: Had that stern command not checked them, the Osaka troops would surely have been branded rebels incapable of weighing the Toyotomi house against the two ancient capitals, earning infamy for all time.
units.source_zh: 若无严令相阻，大坂军定会被人看作不知丰臣氏和两大古都孰轻孰重的乱兵，留下千古骂名。

paragraphs.source_zh: “必保京都和奈良！”这是家康下达的严令。若无严令相阻，大坂军定会被人看作不知丰臣氏和两大古都孰轻孰重的乱兵，留下千古骂名。

paragraphs.source_en: At this critical moment, Asano Nagaakira marched out with five thousand troops while keeping watch for an uprising among his own subjects. This secretly delighted Ōno Harufusa: Nagaakira had taken the bait. For Harufusa’s strategy was to lure out the Asano army, then seize an opportunity to incite rioters to attack Wakayama Castle and strike from both sides.

units.source_en: At this critical moment, Asano Nagaakira marched out with five thousand troops while keeping watch for an uprising among his own subjects.
units.source_zh: 浅野长晟就是在此千钧一发之际，在留心领民暴乱的同时，率五千兵马出征。

units.source_en: This secretly delighted Ōno Harufusa: Nagaakira had taken the bait.
units.source_zh: 这却令大野治房暗喜：长晟中计！

units.source_en: For Harufusa’s strategy was to lure out the Asano army, then seize an opportunity to incite rioters to attack Wakayama Castle and strike from both sides.

ja.t: するというものだった。

units.source_zh: 因治房的战术乃是诱出浅野军，寻机煽动暴民袭击和歌山城，进行两面夹击。

paragraphs.source_zh: 浅野长晟就是在此千钧一发之际，在留心领民暴乱的同时，率五千兵马出征。这却令大野治房暗喜：长晟中计！因治房的战术乃是诱出浅野军，寻机煽动暴民袭击和歌山城，进行两面夹击。

paragraphs.source_en: The Osaka army facing Asano Nagaakira was said by some to number forty thousand and by others twenty thousand. Even if forty thousand was an exaggeration, it still outnumbered Asano’s force of only five thousand several times over.

units.source_en: The Osaka army facing Asano Nagaakira was said by some to number forty thousand and by others twenty thousand. Even if forty thousand was an exaggeration, it still outnumbered Asano’s force of only five thousand several times over.

ja.t: だったとしても、わずか

units.source_zh: 浅野长晟面对的大坂军，有人说是四万，有人说是两万，即便号称四万有些夸张，但对于只有五千兵力的浅野来说，大坂军仍然数倍于他们。

paragraphs.source_zh: 浅野长晟面对的大坂军，有人说是四万，有人说是两万，即便号称四万有些夸张，但对于只有五千兵力的浅野来说，大坂军仍然数倍于他们。

paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-eighth, this exceptionally brutal host advanced from Sakai to the vicinity of Kishiwada and Kaizuka. If the Asano army met it head-on, it would be crushed with ease.

units.source_en: On the twenty-eighth, this exceptionally brutal host advanced from Sakai to the vicinity of Kishiwada and Kaizuka.
units.source_zh: 这样一支极端残暴的队伍，在二十八从堺港行进至岸和田、贝冢附近。

units.source_en: If the Asano army met it head-on, it would be crushed with ease.

ja.t: はひとたまりもなかった。

units.source_zh: 若对其正面迎击，浅野军根本不堪一击。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这样一支极端残暴的队伍，在二十八从堺港行进至岸和田、贝冢附近。若对其正面迎击，浅野军根本不堪一击。

paragraphs.source_en: Ōno Harufusa, commander in chief, had intended to place Ban Dan'emon and Okabe Daigaku in the vanguard, crush Koide Yoshihide at Kishiwada in one stroke, and drive the army into Kii Province. But Koide Yoshihide and Kanamori Arishige, who had come to reinforce him, fought shoulder to shoulder, strictly obeying their orders: they kept the gates shut and refused to move. Harufusa therefore had no choice but to leave Dōken behind to watch Kishiwada Castle while he led the army from Kaizuka toward Sano.

units.source_en: Ōno Harufusa, commander in chief, had intended to place Ban Dan'emon and Okabe Daigaku in the vanguard, crush Koide Yoshihide at Kishiwada in one stroke, and drive the army into Kii Province.
units.source_zh: 总大将大野治房原想命塙团右卫门和冈部大学为先锋，一举击溃岸和田的小出吉英，把队伍推进至纪州。

units.source_en: But Koide Yoshihide and Kanamori Arishige, who had come to reinforce him, fought shoulder to shoulder, strictly obeying their orders: they kept the gates shut and refused to move.
units.source_zh: 但小出吉英和前来增援的金森可重并肩为战，严守军令，紧闭城门，按兵不动。

units.source_en: Harufusa therefore had no choice but to leave Dōken behind to watch Kishiwada Castle while he led the army from Kaizuka toward Sano.
units.source_zh: 治房只好将道犬留下盯住岸和田城，自己率军从贝冢朝佐野进发。

paragraphs.source_zh: 总大将大野治房原想命塙团右卫门和冈部大学为先锋，一举击溃岸和田的小出吉英，把队伍推进至纪州。但小出吉英和前来增援的金森可重并肩为战，严守军令，紧闭城门，按兵不动。治房只好将道犬留下盯住岸和田城，自己率军从贝冢朝佐野进发。

paragraphs.source_en: After the Asano vanguard reached Sano and confirmed that the troops behind were arriving successively at Kashii and Shindachi, it rested briefly so as not to draw too far ahead of the main force.

units.source_en: After the Asano vanguard reached Sano and confirmed that the troops behind were arriving successively at Kashii and Shindachi, it rested briefly so as not to draw too far ahead of the main force.

ja.t: きすぎぬよう、しばらく

units.source_zh: 浅野军的先锋到达佐野以后，确认后续人马已陆续到达樫井、信达，则稍事休整，以与后续部队不差太远。

paragraphs.source_zh: 浅野军的先锋到达佐野以后，确认后续人马已陆续到达樫井、信达，则稍事休整，以与后续部队不差太远。

paragraphs.source_en: The vanguard was commanded by three men: Asano Saemon-no-suke, Asano Ukon, and Kameda Ōsumi. Just as the three had gathered to eat their midday meal, a peasant from Ozaki named Kuemon came running with news that Ōno Harufusa was advancing upon them: “My lords, Ōno Shumanosuke Harufusa is coming with twenty thousand troops. His vanguard may already have reached Kaizuka.”

units.source_en: The vanguard was commanded by three men: Asano Saemon-no-suke, Asano Ukon, and Kameda Ōsumi.
units.source_zh: 先头部队的大将为浅野左卫门佐、浅野右近和龟田大隅三人。

units.source_en: Just as the three had gathered to eat their midday meal, a peasant from Ozaki named Kuemon came running with news that Ōno Harufusa was advancing upon them: “My lords, Ōno Shumanosuke Harufusa is coming with twenty thousand troops. His vanguard may already have reached Kaizuka.”
units.source_zh: 正当三人聚在一处准备用午饭时，尾崎一个叫九右卫门的百姓奔来，禀报大野治房已朝此杀来之信：“报告大人，大野主马亮治房率两万大军杀来，先头许已至贝冢。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 先头部队的大将为浅野左卫门佐、浅野右近和龟田大隅三人。正当三人聚在一处准备用午饭时，尾崎一个叫九右卫门的百姓奔来，禀报大野治房已朝此杀来之信：“报告大人，大野主马亮治房率两万大军杀来，先头许已至贝冢。”

paragraphs.source_en: Until then, the Asano army had been unable to ascertain the enemy’s movements.

units.source_en: Until then, the Asano army had been unable to ascertain the enemy’s movements.

ja.t: きをまったくつかめずにいた。

units.source_zh: 在此之前，浅野军始终未摸清敌军动向。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在此之前，浅野军始终未摸清敌军动向。

paragraphs.source_en: “This is grave! Send someone at once to learn whether it is true.”

units.source_en: “This is grave!
units.source_zh: “大事不好！

units.source_en: Send someone at once to learn whether it is true.”
units.source_zh: 速派人前去探听虚实。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大事不好！速派人前去探听虚实。”

paragraphs.source_en: The scouts soon returned and reported, “The enemy has indeed reached Kaizuka.”

units.source_en: The scouts soon returned and reported, “The enemy has indeed reached Kaizuka.”
units.source_zh: 探事的不久便回报：“敌军确已至贝冢。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 探事的不久便回报：“敌军确已至贝冢。”

paragraphs.source_en: “How many men?”

units.source_en: “How many men?”
units.source_zh: “多少人马？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “多少人马？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Ōno Harufusa, Ban Naoyuki, Okabe Noritsuna, Mishuku Masatomo, Yoneda Kenmotsu, and the others have joined forces and claim twenty thousand men.”

units.source_en: “Ōno Harufusa, Ban Naoyuki, Okabe Noritsuna, Mishuku Masatomo, Yoneda Kenmotsu, and the others have joined forces and claim twenty thousand men.”
units.source_zh: “大野治房、塙直之、冈部则纲、御宿正友、米田监物等人合军一处，号称两万。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大野治房、塙直之、冈部则纲、御宿正友、米田监物等人合军一处，号称两万。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Twenty thousand?” Asano Saemon-no-suke rose to his feet. “Twenty thousand or thirty thousand, they are no more than a rabble. We shall rout them utterly.”

units.source_en: “Twenty thousand?”
units.source_zh: “两万？”

paragraphs.source_en: In war, victory often depends on the force of the first charge. Their own vanguard numbered fewer than two thousand, but having come this far, retreat would only damage morale. It was for this reason that Asano Saemon-no-suke proposed crushing the enemy in a single onslaught, but Kameda Ōsumi firmly opposed him.

paragraphs.source_en: The withdrawal and redeployment through the rainy night continued until morning. Fortunately, the rain ceased at dawn, but a dense fog immediately descended. Asano Ukon withdrew to Nagataki and Kameda Ōsumi to Yasumatsu, while Asano Saemon-no-suke, who had strongly opposed the retreat from the outset, fell back farther still to the bank of the Kashii River. Nevertheless, each contingent swiftly took up its new position.
